grid_manifest.coordinate_frame: EPSG:3067; bearing clockwise from grid north; lateral positive left
grid_manifest.timing_scope: Sequential in-process production API, including snapping/search/rendering; excludes serialization, startup and plotting
grid_manifest.sampling_order: forward, lateral, width; widths share the bounded native graph cache
grid_manifest.limitations: One start and fixed preferences; heuristic bounded routing; no fitted proxy or optimizer

signals.unavailable_reason: Crossing passage attribution is not prepared.

busy_roads.unavailable_reason: Buffered road context is not prepared.

greenery.unavailable_reason: Buffered green-area context is not prepared.

feature_computation.source: Two unpenalized directed Dijkstra searches; no loop-length labels used as features
feature_computation.budget_selection: Maximum observed feasible leg plus 100 m sets search extent only; feature values are independent shortest distances

definitions.u_v: snapped forward and lateral displacement in metres
definitions.b: outward + returning unpenalized directed network distance in metres
definitions.r_km_detour_km: r_km = r/1000; detour_km = (b-2*r)/1000; corresponding coefficients are in metres
definitions.network_anchored: b + fitted r*a and r*a^2 terms; all other models are sums of fitted terms
definitions.residual: actual minus predicted physical loop length, in metres

validation.method: Leave one spatial block out; all widths and both sides grouped by position
validation.noisy_observations: Excluded missing, deadline, area-limited and planner-error evaluations; no fabricated labels
